hero.headlinePart1: Attention training that gives your people
hero.subtitle: A scientifically proven six-week method: one live hour a week and 15 minutes a day. Your people learn to notice tension earlier, interrupt automatic reactions and take back control of their day.

problem.title: The training everyone says yes to and nobody attends.
problem.quote: We have already done a lot. Mindfulness training, stress training. But what we see is that people want to, and then don't actually come.

mindfulness.title: A mindfulness training
mindfulness.lead: Well received by the people who came.

stress.title: A stress workshop
stress.fade: Nothing left of it by week six.

problem.paragraph1: The content was rarely the problem. <0>People under pressure do not sign up for an extra hour.</0> They mean to, they say so, and then the hour arrives and there is marking to do, or a meeting ran over, or going home simply wins. The people who would benefit most are reliably the ones who do not come.
problem.paragraph2: So we did not design a better workshop. <0>We designed a different format.</0> One built around the week people actually have.

approach.title: Six weeks, measured at both ends.
approach.paragraph: Every session is live, with the same trainer and the same group. Week one and week seven are the same measurement. So nobody has to take our word for whether anything moved.

methodology.body1: The core of our brain training is strengthening the "control centre" for rational choices, focus and conscious action, plus the "warning system" that catches stress signals earlier. The result? Less stress and a sharper focus!

cookiebanner.title: About <0>cookies</0>
cookiebanner.body: Innerleaps uses cookies and similar techniques when you visit the website. Not the kind you eat, but small (temporary) text files and scripts. They save you filling in the same details twice or downloading the same things again. Handy! Besides functional cookies, which keep the website working, we use analytics cookies to understand how you use the site. That is how we make it better and clearer. We also use marketing cookies for personalised adverts that match your interests. For that we sometimes share data with our partners.

panel.title: Your <0>cookie preferences</0>
panel.intro: Choose below what we may measure. Your choice stands until you change it.
panel.necessaryBody: Needed to make the site work, for instance to remember your language and this cookie choice.
panel.analyticsBody: Shows us which pages get visited and where people drop off, so we can improve the site.
panel.adsBody: Shows us which advert brought someone here, so we do not pay for what does not work.

cookiebanner.bodyChoice: Want to know more? It is all in our <0>cookie notice</0> and <1>privacy notice</1>. Below you say whether you accept everything, or set your cookies yourself. Change your mind later? No problem, you can adjust your preferences at the bottom of any page.
